summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small vue-demi re-export shim but declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, extracts it, and invokes the Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js` at `npm install` time. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using string-array obfuscation (numeric/string constant pool with a shuffling permutation function `WV8StW`), so its behavior is not inspectable via Node-based tooling. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute a large obfuscated bundle during install is inconsistent with the advertised purpose (a trivial vue-demi shim) and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the runtime install is a mechanism to run opaque, unverified code on the installer's machine before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
